articles.title: New cardamom crop fetches Rs. 95,000 per 40 kg - The Rising Nepal
articles.description: The new crop of large cardamom has started fetching Rs. 95,000 per man (40 kg) in Taplejung. The new crop, which began arriving in the market two to three days ago, is being traded at the rate of Rs. 95,000 per man.

articles.title: Spices Board exploring feasibility of indoor saffron farming in Kerala - The Hindu
articles.description: Spices Board proposes indoor saffron farming in Kerala to boost agriculture and meet rising market demand for saffron.

articles.title: Cardamom export thru Kakarbhitta rises sharply in last FY - The Rising Nepal
articles.description: According to the Customs Office, cardamom export grew by 64.6 per cent in the last fiscal year compared to the fiscal year 2081/82 BS, when exports stood at Rs 7.67 billion.

articles.title: Farmers Earn Millions from Cardamom Cultivation in Ilam - Ratopati
articles.description: Ilam. Farmer Krishna Budhathoki of Simle, Mangsebung Rural Municipality-3, Ilam, has cultivated cardamom on 23 ropanis of land. He started cultivating cardamom three years ago, expanding his cardamom cultivation by clearing paddy fields. He earns lakhs annually by selling cardamom. This year alone, he earned Rs 1.7 million by selling cardamom. He said that he sold cardamom at the rate of Rs 100,000 per man (40 kg).
